title: backup: file created world-readable before chmod 0600
description: kithctl/backup.rs:36-37 — rusqlite::Connection::open(&dest_path) creates the file before std::fs::set_permissions restricts it to 0o600. On a shared system (any user on the same host), the backup DB is briefly world-readable. Fix: set umask to 0o177 around the Connection::open call, or create the file with O_CREAT|0o600 via OpenOptions before calling rusqlite.
